_note: Per-city local facts (lat/lon approx; areas/roads are real landmarks and roads; note is one factual sentence). Do not add reviews, prices, stats or addresses.

homestead.note: Homestead is the gateway to Everglades and Biscayne national parks, so it is a long run south for our van and worth booking ahead.

areas: the Everglades National Park entrance corridor
florida-city.note: Florida City is the southern end of the mainland road network and the start of the Overseas Highway toward the Keys.

cutler-bay.note: Cutler Bay sits along Biscayne Bay in southern Miami-Dade, mostly reached via US-1 and Old Cutler Road.

palmetto-bay.note: Palmetto Bay is a residential village on Biscayne Bay between Cutler Bay and Pinecrest.

pinecrest.note: Pinecrest is a village of larger residential lots, so please include a gate code or driveway note when you request a visit.

areas: the South Miami Metrorail station area
south-miami.note: South Miami is a compact city with a walkable downtown, wedged between US-1 and Red Road.

coral-gables.note: Coral Gables has tree-lined residential streets and a busy downtown business district, so we confirm parking and street access before arrival.

areas: Calle Ocho west of the Gables
west-miami.note: West Miami is a small city along the Tamiami Trail, close to Coral Gables and Sweetwater.

areas: the FIU Modesto Maidique campus area
sweetwater.note: Sweetwater sits at the western edge of urban Miami-Dade near the Dolphin Expressway.

doral.note: Doral mixes office parks, warehouses and residential communities, so we can meet you at home or at a workplace lot.

kendall.note: Kendall is a large, mostly residential part of western Miami-Dade, so an exact street address helps us plan the route.

westchester.note: Westchester is a dense residential area west of Coral Gables, served from our Sunrise base by way of the Palmetto Expressway.

miami.note: Miami has many high-rise and garage parking situations, so tell us where the vehicle is parked and whether the spot has room to work.

areas: Bill Baggs Cape Florida State Park
key-biscayne.note: Key Biscayne is an island village reached by the Rickenbacker Causeway, so please book ahead for visits there.

miami-beach.note: Miami Beach is a barrier island reached by causeway, with limited street parking, so we plan around your building's access and parking rules.

areas: the area around Miami International Airport
virginia-gardens.note: Virginia Gardens is a very small village next to Miami Springs and Miami International Airport.

medley.note: Medley is known for warehouses and industrial operations, so we can meet you at a business lot as well as at home.

hialeah-gardens.note: Hialeah Gardens is on the western side of Hialeah, close to the Palmetto Expressway.

hialeah.note: Hialeah is one of Miami-Dade's largest cities, with many apartment and driveway situations, so an exact address matters.

areas: the area around Miami International Airport
miami-springs.note: Miami Springs is a residential city just north of Miami International Airport.

opa-locka.note: Opa-locka is known for its Moorish Revival architecture and its general-aviation airport.

areas: the Biscayne Bay islands along the 79th Street Causeway
north-bay-village.note: North Bay Village is a small island community on the 79th Street Causeway between Miami and Miami Beach.

miami-shores.note: Miami Shores is a residential village on Biscayne Boulevard, home to Barry University.

el-portal.note: El Portal is a small residential village beside Miami Shores.

biscayne-park.note: Biscayne Park is a small residential village of tree-lined streets bordering North Miami and Miami Shores.

bay-harbor-islands.note: Bay Harbor Islands is a two-island town on Biscayne Bay with compact streets and limited street parking.

surfside.note: Surfside is a small oceanfront town where many vehicles are parked in building garages, so please tell us where yours is.

bal-harbour.note: Bal Harbour is an oceanfront village with condo buildings and garage parking, so confirm access details when you book.

areas: Museum of Contemporary Art North Miami
north-miami.note: North Miami stretches from Biscayne Bay inland along Biscayne Boulevard and NE 125th Street.

miami-lakes.note: Miami Lakes is a planned community with business parks, so we can meet you at home or at the office.

miami-gardens.note: Miami Gardens is home to Hard Rock Stadium and is a short hop from our Broward County service area.

north-miami-beach.note: North Miami Beach is an inland city west of Sunny Isles Beach along NE 163rd Street.

indian-creek.note: Indian Creek is a tiny, gated island village in Biscayne Bay, so access arrangements need to be confirmed before the van arrives.

sunny-isles-beach.note: Sunny Isles Beach is a strip of oceanfront high-rises, so garage and valet access should be sorted out before we arrive.

aventura.note: Aventura is a dense city of condos and offices near the Broward line, with its own garage-parking situations.

golden-beach.note: Golden Beach is a small oceanfront town at Miami-Dade's northern edge.

hallandale-beach.note: Hallandale Beach sits right on the Broward-Miami-Dade line, close to our Sunrise shop by way of Hallandale Beach Boulevard and I-95.

pembroke-park.note: Pembroke Park is a small town on the Hollywood and Hallandale Beach border.

west-park.note: West Park is a small residential city along Pembroke Road and State Road 7.

miramar.note: Miramar is a large residential city in southwest Broward with easy access to I-75 and the Turnpike.

pembroke-pines.note: Pembroke Pines is one of Broward's largest cities, so we ask for your exact address and the closest cross street.

areas: the Dykes Road and Griffin Road area
southwest-ranches.note: Southwest Ranches is a rural, large-lot town of equestrian-style properties, so please tell us about gates and long driveways when you book.

cooper-city.note: Cooper City is a mostly residential city next to Davie and Pembroke Pines.

weston.note: Weston is a planned community of gated neighborhoods, so please share any gate code or visitor-access steps when you book.

davie.note: Davie has a Western-themed downtown and many larger rural-style lots, and it is a short drive from our Sunrise shop.

hollywood.note: Hollywood stretches from the Broadwalk to I-95 and beyond, so we confirm your exact address first.

dania-beach.note: Dania Beach neighbors Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport and has a historic antique district on US-1.

fort-lauderdale.note: Fort Lauderdale has many downtown garages and waterfront condos, so tell us where the vehicle is parked.

lauderhill.note: Lauderhill is right next door to Sunrise along Oakland Park Boulevard.

plantation.note: Plantation is a close neighbor of our Sunrise shop, reached via Broward Boulevard or University Drive.

sunrise.note: Sunrise is our home base: the shop is at 7712 West Oakland Park Boulevard, and the van starts its day here.

lauderdale-lakes.note: Lauderdale Lakes is a short drive east of our Sunrise shop along Oakland Park Boulevard.

tamarac.note: Tamarac is a residential city with many condo and community parking lots, so we check the community's rules for vendor visits.

north-lauderdale.note: North Lauderdale is a compact residential city west of I-95 and north of Tamarac.

oakland-park.note: Oakland Park shares its main road with our shop: Oakland Park Boulevard runs straight from Sunrise to the coast.

wilton-manors.note: Wilton Manors is a compact island city around Wilton Drive, so on-street parking may need a quick plan.

areas: the Oakland Park and Wilton Manors area
lazy-lake.note: Lazy Lake is one of Broward's smallest municipalities, near Wilton Manors and Oakland Park, so we serve it along the same route.

lauderdale-by-the-sea.note: Lauderdale-by-the-Sea is a small beachfront town along A1A where street parking is tight.

margate.note: Margate sits in north-central Broward and is a straight shot from Sunrise up the Turnpike.

coconut-creek.note: Coconut Creek is known for Tradewinds Park and Butterfly World.

pompano-beach.note: Pompano Beach runs from the Intracoastal inland to I-95, so we confirm your exact address before dispatch.

lighthouse-point.note: Lighthouse Point is a quiet residential city on the Intracoastal Waterway near Hillsboro Inlet.

sea-ranches.note: Sea Ranches is a very small oceanside village on Broward's northern coast.

hillsboro-beach.note: Hillsboro Beach is a narrow oceanfront town along A1A on Broward's northern coast.

areas: Coral Springs Center for the Arts
coral-springs.note: Coral Springs is a large planned city in northwest Broward, a straight run north from our Sunrise shop.

parkland.note: Parkland is a residential city of larger lots and gated communities on Broward's northern edge.

deerfield-beach.note: Deerfield Beach is the last Broward city before Palm Beach County and reachable via I-95 or the Turnpike.

boca-raton.note: Boca Raton is the first major Palm Beach County city north of Broward and an easy trip up I-95 or the Turnpike.

highland-beach.note: Highland Beach is a narrow barrier-island town between Boca Raton and Delray Beach, so most visits are along A1A.

delray-beach.note: Delray Beach has a busy Atlantic Avenue downtown and plenty of residential areas west of I-95.

boynton-beach.note: Boynton Beach is a large city that spans from the Intracoastal Waterway to west of the Turnpike.

gulf-stream.note: Gulf Stream is a very small, quiet oceanfront town in southern Palm Beach County.

ocean-ridge.note: Ocean Ridge is a barrier-island town between Boynton Beach and the Intracoastal Waterway.

briny-breezes.note: Briny Breezes is a small, cooperatively owned oceanfront community on A1A, so please give us full access details.

hypoluxo.note: Hypoluxo is a small town on the Lake Worth Lagoon between Boynton Beach and Lantana.

manalapan.note: Manalapan is a quiet, oceanfront town on a barrier island south of Palm Beach.

lantana.note: Lantana is a small town on the Lake Worth Lagoon, an easy hop from Lake Worth Beach and Boynton Beach.

greenacres.note: Greenacres is a residential city west of Lake Worth Beach in central Palm Beach County.

atlantis.note: Atlantis is a small city in central Palm Beach County, near Lantana and Greenacres.

areas: the Lake Worth Beach and Palm Springs area
glen-ridge.note: Glen Ridge is one of Palm Beach County's smallest towns, next to Lake Worth Beach.

areas: the Lake Worth Beach Casino complex
lake-worth-beach.note: Lake Worth Beach (formerly Lake Worth) has a walkable downtown around Lake Avenue and an oceanfront pier.

palm-springs.note: Palm Springs is a village in central Palm Beach County, next to Lake Worth Beach and Greenacres.

haverhill.note: Haverhill is a very small town in the West Palm Beach area.

areas: the West Palm Beach and Lake Worth Beach area
cloud-lake.note: Cloud Lake is one of Palm Beach County's smallest towns, in the Lake Worth-West Palm Beach area.

areas: the Boynton Beach and Lake Worth Beach area
golf.note: Golf is a small village in central Palm Beach County, served along our Boynton Beach and Lake Worth Beach routes.

lake-clarke-shores.note: Lake Clarke Shores is a small residential town on the Lake Clarke waterway in central Palm Beach County.

wellington.note: Wellington is a major equestrian center in western Palm Beach County and a long run west from the coast.

areas: the Royal Palm Beach Boulevard corridor
royal-palm-beach.note: Royal Palm Beach is a residential village in the western communities along State Road 7.

areas: the B Road and D Road area
loxahatchee-groves.note: Loxahatchee Groves is a rural, large-lot town west of Wellington, so please send exact directions and gate details.

westlake.note: Westlake is a newer planned city in western Palm Beach County.

south-palm-beach.note: South Palm Beach is a tiny barrier-island town south of Lake Worth Beach.

palm-beach.note: Palm Beach is a barrier island reached by bridge, with strict street parking, so we plan access with you first.

palm-beach-shores.note: Palm Beach Shores is a small town on Singer Island.

west-palm-beach.note: West Palm Beach is the county seat of Palm Beach County and home to Palm Beach International Airport.

areas: the Tri-Rail Mangonia Park station area
mangonia-park.note: Mangonia Park is a small town between West Palm Beach and Riviera Beach.

riviera-beach.note: Riviera Beach is a port city with Singer Island to the east, and a long drive from Sunrise, so book early.

lake-park.note: Lake Park is a small town between North Palm Beach and Riviera Beach along US-1.

north-palm-beach.note: North Palm Beach is a village on the Intracoastal Waterway with winding residential streets.

palm-beach-gardens.note: Palm Beach Gardens is a large city of residential and resort communities in northern Palm Beach County.

juno-beach.note: Juno Beach is a small oceanfront town known for its pier and its sea turtle center.

tequesta.note: Tequesta is a village on the Loxahatchee River near Jupiter, at the north end of our service area.

jupiter-inlet-colony.note: Jupiter Inlet Colony is a tiny town next to Jupiter Inlet.

jupiter.note: Jupiter is the northern anchor of our service area, a long drive from Sunrise, so please book ahead.

belle-glade.note: Belle Glade is an agricultural community on Lake Okeechobee, and a long run west from the coast, so please book ahead.

areas: the south shore of Lake Okeechobee
south-bay.note: South Bay is a small community on the south shore of Lake Okeechobee.

pahokee.note: Pahokee sits on the east shore of Lake Okeechobee, a long drive from the coast, so please book ahead.

Miami-Dade.note: Miami-Dade covers everything from Homestead and Florida City in the south to Aventura and Golden Beach at the Broward line, including Miami, Coral Gables, Doral and Miami Beach. Main routes include I-95, the Palmetto Expressway (SR 826), the Dolphin Expressway (SR 836), US-1 and Florida's Turnpike.

Broward.note: Broward is where our shop sits. Sunrise is our home base on Oakland Park Boulevard, and the county runs from Hallandale Beach in the south to Deerfield Beach in the north, including Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood, Pembroke Pines, Weston and Coral Springs. Main routes include I-95, I-595, I-75, the Sawgrass Expressway (SR 869) and Florida's Turnpike.

Palm Beach.note: Palm Beach County stretches from Boca Raton in the south to Jupiter in the north, and west to Wellington and the Lake Okeechobee communities of Belle Glade, South Bay and Pahokee. The coastal cities are a straight run up I-95 or the Turnpike, while the western communities are a longer drive, so book ahead.
